# dmeim.com

> Personal site of Dimitrios Meimaridis (dmeim), an IT manager, administrator, and computer teacher with over eight years of experience running technology in PreK-8 schools, as well as corporate and higher-education environments.

The site is static. Every page is plain HTML, and nothing behind it needs a login.

## Pages

- [Home](https://dmeim.com/): About, experience, skills, and education.
- [Projects](https://dmeim.com/projects): Write-ups and screenshots of things Dimitri has built.
- [Gallery](https://dmeim.com/gallery): Albums of the photos, icons, and screenshots the site uses.
- [Tools](https://dmeim.com/tools): Small in-browser utilities for encoding, conversion, networking, and more. Nothing typed into them leaves the browser.
- [Keys](https://dmeim.com/keys): Public SSH and GPG keys.
- [Orthodox](https://dmeim.com/orthodox): Orthodox Christian icons and a full-screen icon-wall screensaver.
- [Game of Life](https://dmeim.com/game-of-life): Conway's Game of Life, with a full-page simulator.
